name: 20132 · Purcellville, VA
findings: ZIP 20132 (Purcellville) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20132 (Purcellville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
